title: Conveyor Jam and Obstruction
symptoms: Motor current rises while conveyor speed drops. A foreign object or trapped product may be visible.
procedure: Confirm the conveyor is stopped by the deterministic controller.
Keep restart authorization disabled while the obstruction remains unresolved.
Notify the operator and request a visual inspection.
Require an authorized person to follow the site's isolation and lockout procedure before any physical intervention.
After the obstruction is resolved by authorized personnel, obtain fresh sensor readings.
Require fault acknowledgement, successful interlock checks, and explicit operator approval before a simulated restart.
restart_policy: Never restart automatically based only on AI observations.

title: Motor Overheating
symptoms: Motor temperature exceeds the simulated safety threshold.
procedure: Confirm the deterministic controller has stopped the machine.
Do not bypass temperature interlocks.
Notify authorized maintenance personnel.
Investigate possible overload, cooling problems, and abnormal operating conditions using approved site procedures.
Require fresh normal temperature readings and verified interlocks before requesting restart approval.
restart_policy: A temperature returning to normal does not automatically clear a latched fault.

title: High Vibration
symptoms: The simulated vibration measurement exceeds the configured limit.
procedure: Confirm the conveyor has stopped.
Do not attempt an automatic restart.
Request inspection by authorized maintenance personnel.
Check for possible alignment or bearing issues under approved maintenance procedures.
Require acceptable fresh readings and deterministic safety validation before restart approval.
restart_policy: AI cannot authorize operation while vibration faults are active.

title: Misaligned Product
symptoms: A product appears rotated, displaced, or contacting a conveyor guide.
procedure: Record the visual observation as a suspected misalignment.
Confirm machine state using the deterministic controller.
Request operator inspection of the product and guide area.
Require approved isolation procedures before any physical adjustment.
Use fresh sensor readings and operator approval before any simulated restart.
restart_policy: Visual alignment alone does not establish safe restart conditions.

title: Emergency Stop and Guard Interlock
symptoms: An emergency-stop input is active or the protective guard is open.
procedure: Maintain the stopped state.
Do not bypass the emergency-stop or guard interlock.
Require authorized personnel to determine why the safety device was activated.
Restore the safety device only after the underlying hazard has been addressed.
Require fault acknowledgement, interlock validation, and explicit approval before simulated restart.
restart_policy: Releasing an emergency stop or closing a guard never automatically restarts the conveyor.

title: Invalid or Stale Sensor Data
symptoms: Sensor readings are missing, invalid, inconsistent, or too old for a recovery decision.
procedure: Do not authorize restart using invalid or stale readings.
Request a fresh sensor acquisition.
Notify the operator if the sensor problem persists.
Validate the data and safety interlocks before requesting restart approval.
restart_policy: Missing or stale safety evidence must not be interpreted as a safe condition.
